evf.settings.pair_hint: Show the QR to scan with the FoundryVTT G2 HUD app. Your Foundry tab then streams your character to the glasses — no GM, no extra login.
evf.settings.app_url_hint: Page the pairing QR opens. Leave the default unless you develop or self-host the app.
evf.settings.relay_url_hint: WebSocket relay your tab and the glasses meet on (wss://…). Leave the default unless you develop or self-host it.
evf.keybinding.pair_hint: Opens the pairing QR for your character.
evf.pair.title: EvenFoundryVTT · Connect G2 glasses
evf.pair.no_actor: You don't own a character yet: ask the GM to give you one, then open this window again.
evf.pair.step1: On the phone open FoundryVTT G2 HUD (Even Hub) and tap «Scan QR» — or scan with the Even Realities App
evf.pair.step2: The sheet appears on the glasses. Keep this Foundry tab open while you play
evf.pair.single_use: Single use: it stops working once the glasses connect.
evf.pair.relay_down: This browser cannot reach the relay
evf.pair.connected.title: Glasses connected
evf.pair.connected.body: They reconnect by themselves whenever this browser has Foundry open.
evf.pair.devices.heading: Glasses connected to this browser
evf.pair.error.pair: Could not create the QR (see the console).
evf.pair.error.clipboard: Clipboard not available: copy the code by hand.
evf.pair.error.revoke: Could not disconnect the glasses (see the console).
